CustomField.formula:
IF( AND(Business_Hours_Total__c >= Business_Hours_Now__c, Business_Hours_Now__c > 0),
1 / Business_Hours_Total__c * Business_Hours_Now__c, IF( OR( Business_Hours_Now__c <= 0, Business_Hours_Total__c <=0 ), NULL,
1 ))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The estimated percentage of completion of the story so far, calculated based on the start date / time and the end date / time
CustomField.label: Estimated Percentage
